name: Nicolás Sánchez-Fuenzalida
role: Former PhD Candidate and Postdoctoral Researcher
bio:
I did my PhD at the Conscious Brain Lab in October 2018 fully funded by the National Commission for Scientific and Technological Research (CONICYT-Chile) investigating the role of consciousness in decisional threshold changes combining behavioural and physiological methods. In September 2023 I started a Postdoc at the Free University Amsterdam on the Templeton Grant "a statistical framework for establishing unconscious cognition" with Johannes Fahrenfort.
​
I graduated in Psychology (BS) and Philosophy (MS) at the University Diego Portales. Before starting my PhD and PostDoc I worked as a research assistant at the Center of Social and Cognitive Neuroscience where I studied Bayesian reasoning and health information communication.
